title: VanillaCore+
description: Vanilla Core+ is a lightweight essentials modpack that enhances the classic Minecraft experience with must-have tweaks, optimizations, and quality-of-life improvements without breaking the vanilla feel
body: Vanilla Core+ is the perfect essentials modpack for players who love the classic Minecraft experience but want a smoother, more convenient adventure. This pack includes must-have tweaks, optimizations, and quality-of-life improvements without changing the core gameplay. From performance boosts to small but useful features, Vanilla Core+ keeps everything feeling natural while enhancing your journey. Whether you're building, exploring, or surviving, this pack ensures a refined vanilla experience without unnecessary extras.
